risk_note: RV2 (new risk table + ledger approve path). BR-FUND-12 关联账户风控标记, minimal shape per D10-727 ③ / D10-590 ⑤ / D10-758 / D10-767: migration 0128 creates the insert-only table app.risk_linked_marks (app, marked user, written-off user, candidate, dimension; unique per (app, candidate, user, dimension); no plaintext or HMAC; couli_app SELECT / INSERT only) plus four lookup indexes on devices / payout_accounts (non-concurrent, accepted by the orchestrator; header comment says later such indexes need a CONCURRENTLY migration). risk's single writer is called on ledger's approving transaction right after the BAD_DEBT_WRITEOFF voucher; CANCELLED and frozen refusals mark nothing; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Dimensions this round: device (device_hash of every device on the written-off member's sessions, revoked included, D10-571) and payout_account (all payout_accounts rows incl. history; Alipay and bank card only, there is no WeChat column). Same-realname is not built (D10-767: needs the isolated prior identities; FU-BAD-DEBT-LINKED-REALNAME). Trace only: no withdrawal decision reads the marks. Rows stay on deletion like risk_hits (BR-ID-30). Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners off, D10-555).

reviews.note: r1 fail (S1 current-only payout match unreachable under the is_current unique index; S1 device id misses a reinstall's new row) → rule tests attempt 2, implementation r2; r2 fail only because the brief still asked for same-realname after D10-767 → brief §13 added; r3 pass, 0 findings (couli-runs/B2-12g/review-money-r1.saved.json, review-money-r2-stale-brief.json, review-money-r3.json); Codex unavailable (approvals #36)

spec_test_review.note: rule tests by independent Claude through claude-run.sh: attempt 1, attempt 2 (history rows, device_hash), attempt 3 (same-realname) dropped per D10-767 (kept on backup/B2-12g-with-attempt3, not landed); red PASS 12 → 15 tests; spec-test r1 pass, r2 fail on the stale brief (same-realname), r3 pass with one S2 recorded (no case gives one member two dimensions; test attempts exhausted per the orchestrator) (couli-runs/B2-12g/review-spec-r1.json, review-spec-r2-stale-brief.json, review-spec-r3.json)

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
